subject: Re: BlueFrontier renewal — term amendment, capacity add, and billing handoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@bluefrontier.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@bluefrontier.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity add — draft amendment + billing handoff request

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. To recap: BlueFrontier is renewing for another 12 months and adding a 25% capacity uplift (dedicated pool) starting with the next billing cycle. I attached a draft amendment that shows the updated committed capacity and the price schedule (Renewal_Amendment_2026.docx).

Two operational items we need to lock down to process the amendment and the first invoice:
- PO: Please share the PO number you want us to reference on invoices for the uplift.
- Billing contact & net terms: You mentioned AP is taking over billing; can you confirm the billing contact and whether Net45 is acceptable (we can update the contract to reflect Net45 vs Net30)?
- Tax forms: we typically need an updated W-9 (US customers) or appropriate VAT evidence for EU entities — if you can attach the signed W-9 that speeds up things.

If it helps, I can push the amendment to DocuSign once you confirm the billing contact and PO, and we’ll route the first invoice to the AP contact.

Next steps I propose: you confirm (1) PO number, (2) AP name/email for invoicing, (3) preferred net terms. I’ll then: upload the amendment to DocuSign, notify Finance to expect the PO, and attach the W-9 to our billing record.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out so the uplift can start on schedule.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Renewal_Amendment_2026.docx (draft amendment, redlines enabled)

Could you please:

2) Prepare to accept PO BF-2026-6789 — I’ll upload the final amendment to DocuSign as soon as I have confirmation from Priya.
3) Confirm whether we should invoice monthly for the uplift (recommended) or send a single invoice for the uplift upfront. If monthly, set billing cadence to monthly starting with the next billing cycle.
4) Keep an eye out for the W-9 — I’ll attach it to the deal record when I receive it.

If there are any special steps for EFT setup or payor mapping to capture (BlueFrontier asked about EFT routing), loop in payments-ops.

Thanks — please reply with any questions or confirmation of the changes and I’ll finalize the DocuSign transaction.

—Jordan
